name: Pillow
dimensions: Length 29.8 cm; Width 23.5 cm; Height 12 cm
summary: This octagonal ceramic pillow is an example of Cizhou ware. Cizhou is a term used to describe a variety of ceramics made in northern China during the Song dynasty (960-1279).
